question: Does the BB72 v1 BP-SF gain at p=0.08 replicate, and how does it depend on canonical SPA versus min-sum updates, V2C damping, and BP-only sweep allowance?
claim_scope: Independent controlled X-only BB72 CSS adaptation. The min-sum BP-SF arm remains different from the source's unseeded parallel first-arrival execution; no author-code reproduction or parallel-latency claim.

artifact.source_status: Bravyi source-pinned [[72,12,6]] matrices; project-derived ordered logical basis

cohort.v1_overlap_rule: new physical sample namespace and seed; no v1 shot is reused or pooled

shared_work.cost_reporting: Report BP messages and calls, all additional typed intervention work, and measured controller runtime separately. A common message cap is not equal total work or parallel latency.
shared_work.runtime_method: time.perf_counter_ns:phase5-controller:v1 for intervention arms; ordinary canonical decode runtime for BP-only arms
shared_work.runtime_comparison_status: same-node descriptive serial execution only; different measurement scopes and control overhead are disclosed

assessment.primary_endpoint: unconditional_failure; only exact or stabilizer-equivalent recovery is valid
assessment.test: two-sided exact paired McNemar on discordant matched shots
assessment.multiplicity: Holm familywise correction across the two p080 primary contrasts at alpha=0.05
assessment.secondary: All p050 contrasts, gamma=0.5 arms, BP20 controls, outcome transitions, typed work and runtime are descriptive with exact binomial intervals; no unadjusted directional claims.
assessment.rate_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson on every all-terminal denominator
assessment.decision_rule: A primary contrast is directional only with Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 and matching observed sign. Otherwise inconclusive; no general decoder ranking follows from BB72 alone.

sample_size_basis.method: exact binomial rejection region, binomial mixture over discordant count, conservative two-sided alpha=0.025 per primary contrast
sample_size_basis.qualification: Sensitivity calculation, not a guaranteed effect or power for the unknown min-sum contrast. The v1 effect is not pooled with v2 inference.

source_settings_view.reason: Canonical SPA messages and deterministic seeded test order differ from source min-sum parallel selection.
Min-sum update is source-informed, but seeded serial first-valid selection and fixed BB72 CSS conditions remain different from the paper.
The source BB72 experiment used circuit-level BP-OSD, not perfect-syndrome X-only CSS BP.
